configuration_ratio_audit.question: do the verbatim AFF-1 and AFF-8 forces imply the same configuration ratio as the recorded C_T columns?
configuration_ratio_audit.note: DEFINITIONAL IDENTITY, not physics: both configurations are normalised with the same rho, V and bare-hull S = 5.998 m2, so C_T(AFF-8)/C_T(AFF-1) = R_T(AFF-8)/R_T(AFF-1) exactly. Passing this audit certifies transcription fidelity (the R_T and C_T columns agree), not an independent measurement

doc_rounded_crosscheck.reading: 2-significant-digit transcription; deviation must be read as rounding, not as a 1e-9-class residual

case_vs_anchor_caliber.case_Re_note: the frozen TensorLBM SUBOFF case fixes the lattice Reynolds number u_lb*N/nu_lb = 1000 (u_lb = 0.05, tau = 0.5072 at N = 48); this is the only Reynolds number the case can substantiate
case_vs_anchor_caliber.caliber_reading: ITTC-57 evaluated at Re=1e3 returns 0.075, i.e. the correlation is carried far outside its fitted range (the line has a pole at Re=100 and is a turbulent flat-plate correlation); it cannot be used as the friction anchor of a Re=1e3 laminar LBM case. This is the structural root cause of the five predecessor honest FAILs.
